Crock pot Mongolian beef over rice noodles served with white rice.
Adapted from the best parts of multiple recipes, mainly this one
Recipe - 
Ingredients:
12 oz steak, sliced thinly
1/4 cup cornstarch
2 tbsp oil
1 yellow onion, sliced in small wedges
6-8 green onions, sliced in 1/2 inch increments
1/2 cup water
1/3 cup soy sauce
1/3 cup hoisin sauce
1/4 cup brown sugar
1 clove garlic
1/4 tsp fresh ginger root zest
Crushed red pepper to taste (for a spicy dish)
Method:
Lightly coat steak in corns
